tools.name: get_cost_estimate
tools.description:
[Step 1 of cost_check]

Returns a general cost range and a link to the cost estimate page, pre-filled with the plan and service, where the family sees the exact amount for their plan.

Use when: A parent asks what care costs, about a copay, or whether a plan is covered.

tools.name: get_emora_overview
tools.description:
[Step 1 of explore_information · optional]

Describes Emora Health: services, states served, insurance accepted, ages seen, how care works, and how to reach the care team.

Use when: A parent asks what Emora is, what it offers, where it works, or which plans it takes.

Example: get_emora_overview({}

tools.name: get_crisis_resources
tools.description:
[Step 1 of crisis]

Returns 911, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and the Crisis Text Line, for a child or teen in danger now.

Use when: Any mention of self-harm, suicidal thoughts, or someone in immediate danger.

Example: get_crisis_resources({})
